text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a branch of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. Instead of just reading words as simple text, NLP allows machines to grasp the meaning behind sentences. This technology powers many everyday tools. For example, online translation services can convert a paragraph from English to Japanese while keeping the original sense. Sentiment analysis is another useful application: it scans social media posts or product reviews to determine if the overall feeling is positive, negative, or neutral. Finally, chatbots use NLP to hold conversations with customers, answering questions and solving simple problems automatically. Thanks to NLP, interacting with machines feels much more natural and helpful.
